description: The coarse voxel_key_lN fields are prefixes of voxel_key -- a prefix IS the cube cell that contains it, so they can be derived here instead of by hand in every writer (perception/voxelize.py, fake/scene_gen.py, elastic/records.py each computed their own). Deriving them server-side means changing OCTREE_LEVELS costs one constant, not three writers, and old and new depths agree by construction. elastic/NOTES.md 'octree depth'.

script.source: def k = ctx.voxel_key; for (int n : new int[] {3, 5, 6, 7}) { String f = 'voxel_key_l' + n; if (k != null && k.length() >= n) { ctx[f] = k.substring(0, n); } else { ctx.remove(f); } }
